      "name": "rpc",

      "evidence": "Deprecates and removes the public loadtxoutset RPC method in favor of a startup flag, directly affecting RPC interface compatibility.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Breaking an existing RPC method requires review for interface compatibility and deprecation discipline. Because loadtxoutset is an experimental assumeutxo interface, retiring it in favor of an init argument is an interface cleanup that downstream tooling must accommodate."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "While it introduces a -loadtxoutset startup option, settings and init changes whose primary subject is another subsystem belong to that area.",

    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly restructures assumeutxo snapshot activation and chainstate initialization.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Restricting snapshot loading to node initialization before networking and mempool activation removes a significant concurrency and resource coordination hazard in validation. According to the PR description, this avoids 'coordinating with the active chain, mempool, caches and advertised services while the node is running' and eliminates dynamic cache splitting and resizing."
